purpose: Central checklist for local-search work we can control: clear titles, local wording, service/town routes, internal links, proof, and review freshness.
controlled_ranking_inputs: Unique title and meta description per public route.
One clear H1 on exposed pages.
Town, county, service, booking, proof, and review wording in visible content.
Internal links between services, pricing, gallery, booking, and town pages.
Fresh before/after images and real reviews as they become available.
Complete Google Business Profile service list and matching service-area wording.
next_manual_steps: Replace sample reviews with verified reviews once the review API is connected.
Add one recent before/after job to each priority town page every few months.
Use Search Console to watch impressions, click-through rate, and average position per town/service page.
Keep business name, phone, service area, and package wording consistent with Google Business Profile.
